title: The document outlines the editorial and publishing structure of 'Africa Today', a monthly publication focused on African affairs. It lists key personnel including the Publisher & Editor-in-Chief, Managing Editor, and various regional and contributing editors. The publication covers a range of topics including politics, economics, and sports across different African countries. It also provides advertising information and subscription details, emphasizing its commitment to delivering insightful content about the continent's developments. The latest issue features articles on Nigeria, Sudan, Ethiopia, Togo, South Africa, Sierra Leone, and Guinea, among others.
